pricing_usd_per_mtok.note: Used only to estimate cost from logged tokens. Verify against current Anthropic pricing before reporting.

notes.llm: Every LLM arm (B2, Agentic) reads these settings. Runs refuse to start if anything overrides them, and the evaluator refuses to compare runs made with different settings.
notes.max_attempts: Attempts per LLM call. All LLM arms retry format/schema failures; only the pipeline also retries taxonomy and evidence validation failures.
notes.refusal_fallback: Off: a refusal fails the case instead of being answered by another model.
notes.runs: 3 runs per case for the LLM arms, B1 once. If cost is a concern, use the reduced design: 1 run on all cases plus 3 runs on the stratified 40-case subset.
